components.name: action-bar
components.title: Action bar
components.doc: The one hint, close and back pattern (tokens 1.5): an optional plate, items gap-items apart, each keys (Tile sm) or an icon plus a label, a button when it acts, with a hold level.

components.name: chip
components.title: Chip
components.doc: A short status on one line in two materials: panel (h-chip, r-chip, the label role; fill hair | tint | solid; tone, hue, icon, count, the dot) and hud (the game surface, nk-chip / nk-hud: pill | tile, active, warning).

components.name: dial
components.title: Dial
components.doc: A round gauge (tokens 1.5): one SVG geometry with a track arc, a value arc or segments, ticks (a tick count lever) and an optional needle around your readout; a redline sets data-state="alert".

components.name: fill
components.title: Fill
components.doc: Status as a level filling left to right (tokens 1.5): a track, a bar scaled from the left, a leading edge; hue, tone and one alert threshold (alertAt).

components.name: panel
components.title: Panel
components.doc: The one floating surface: nk-panel with a header (title, description, actions, optional tabs row), a scrolling body and a footer.

components.name: text-roll
components.title: Text Roll
components.doc: A short text that changes like a slot reel: the old value rolls out and the new one in, masked to the line, with direction and per-character stagger; NumberRoll rolls each digit on its own (money, speed, ammo, clocks).

components.name: tile
components.title: Tile
components.doc: The one key language (tokens 1.5): a face with a rim and top light on a solid plate, slanted by --nk-tile-skew while the box stays upright.

components.name: use-linear-run
components.title: useLinearRun
components.doc: The kit's one timed run (Motion): a linear Web Animation per target (transform only, pseudo-elements too: a Fill's bar and edge) on one start time, a completion from a timer (fires with motion off), elapsed, pause and resume, an optional motion gate.

components.name: meter
components.title: Meter
components.doc: A slim bar on a theme or game track, with a caption and value, low/high thresholds that turn it destructive, and optional segments; timed runs; and the timed-progress slab (variant="slab": label, thin line, cancel key), the successor of task-progress.

components.name: speedometer
components.title: Speedometer
components.doc: The in-game vehicle gauge on a Dial: thick rpm segments with even gaps (or a thin arc), the redline, the speed with its leading zeros dimmed, a gear Tile in the opening, fuel as outer segments and the turn signals; speedometerPainter() for live writes.

components.name: vital-chip
components.title: Vital Chip
components.doc: The HUD status chip as composable parts (Root, Shape, Level, Icon, Label, Glyph, Pop): the in-game keycap by default (a Tile face over a plate that slides out with the label, the level as a liquid in the face, white when active), or one SVG path per shape (auto, square, rounded, circle, diamond, hex, chamfer); level fill/outline/bar/none; a pop with the signed change.

components.name: menu-row
components.title: Menu Row
components.doc: The 40px action row: icon, label, description, a progress bar in any tone or colour, and a trailing meta, chevron, kbd trail (one key or several, Tile Kbds), checkbox or value stepper; as="div" for a focusable div with the row look.

components.name: radial-menu
components.title: Radial Menu
components.doc: Action wheel in SVG (shadcn has no radial), styled like shadcn menus: popover, border, accent.

components.name: selection-tabs
components.title: Selection Tabs
components.doc: shadcn Tabs with one SelectionTile sliding to the active trigger (FLIP on --nk-indicator-time/-ease), the lit trigger the keycap tile, triggers --nk-list-gap apart, arrows move it, reduced motion jumps.

components.name: selection-tile
components.title: Selection Tile
components.doc: The one selection mark of a list, tabs or a menu: the primary keycap's face and wall (--nk-tile-*) as one element that slides to the lit item by transform, its size by a measured FLIP.

components.name: confirm
components.title: Confirm
components.doc: Are you sure? Title, body, cancel and one primary or destructive action, a running state and acknowledge-only.

components.name: edge-sheet
components.title: Edge Sheet
components.doc: A full-height sheet flush to a screen edge, the pause menu backdrop and the ox_lib context sheet as one component: stock Sheet (non-modal) in the panel surface, hairline on the open edge, inner column, section-size title with optional back and close buttons, sub-pages that swap in place, a level traced along the header edge, staggered slide-in and a faster exit.

components.name: key-prompt
components.title: Key prompt
components.doc: "[E] Open garage": the prompt slab (key chip + verb) by default, or a panel or HUD surface; keys (none, one or a combination), label that truncates or wraps, description, icon; hold-to-confirm with a filling line, driven by Lua (progress) or by pointer and key when the page has focus; active and disabled; a stack for any edge.

components.name: notice
components.title: Notice
components.doc: A notification on the game (a tone: neutral, info, success, warning or danger, with status as its older name; a hue; an icon, title, description, a time-left line that pauses on hover) and the stack that pins them to any of eight positions, with a useNotices() queue; an item add/remove slab (icon tile, name, delta) whose changes merge within 1.5 s.

components.name: skill-check
components.title: Skill check
components.doc: Press the key while the needle is in the zone: zone start and size (wrapping past 360°), speed, the key, a success or fail outcome.

components.name: smooth-input
components.title: Smooth Input
components.doc: Drop-ins for shadcn Input and Textarea: a caret that glides and breathes in the theme primary, and typed characters that ease in.

components.name: stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.doc: One segmented control for a value picked by stepping: a prev keycap, the value field and a next keycap joined in one rim at --nk-h-control.

blocks.name: death-screen
blocks.title: Death Screen
blocks.doc: Last stand and death over the game: a countdown and bar, call EMS, hold to respawn with a live bar, red at the edges.

blocks.name: hud-minimal
blocks.title: Minimal HUD
blocks.doc: The always-on HUD: voice, vitals and needs as keycaps (VitalChip), cash, bank and job, and the in-game Speedometer with seatbelt and engine warnings while driving.

blocks.name: loading-screen
blocks.title: Loading Screen
blocks.doc: The real load progress (the game's own load events, phase by phase), tips, links, backgrounds and music, in the server's nuikit theme handed over on connect.

blocks.name: job-menu
blocks.title: Job menu
blocks.doc: Your job in one panel: a duty toggle and the job's actions; for the boss, a Staff tab with the job account, promote, demote, fire (with a confirm) and hire whoever is nearby.

blocks.name: job-sheet
blocks.title: Job sheet
blocks.doc: The one frame for a resource's menu: a floating EdgeSheet (docs/design.md, Surfaces) with a header row, sections of 48px rows, sub-pages that swap in place with a back row, and one actions row with a single primary.

blocks.name: pause-menu
blocks.title: Pause Menu
blocks.doc: Esc opens it in place of GTA's: the server and its actions (resume, map, settings, key bindings, disconnect with a confirm) on a rail, the player and the server on cards, the game blurred behind.

blocks.name: settings
blocks.title: Settings
blocks.doc: Player settings in one panel: toggles, choices, sliders and key hints in tabbed sections.

blocks.name: bank
blocks.title: Bank
blocks.doc: Accounts, the selected one's balance and recent transactions, and deposit, withdraw and transfer in a dialog that checks the amount before Lua does.

blocks.name: character-select
blocks.title: Character select
blocks.doc: Who to play: character slots, the chosen one as a PlayerCard with Play and Delete (behind a destructive confirm), spawn points after Play, and a create form with the same rules the server checks.

blocks.name: garage
blocks.title: Garage
blocks.doc: Your vehicles at a garage, filtered by stored, out and impounded, with the selected one's fuel, engine and body.

blocks.name: interaction
blocks.title: Interaction
blocks.doc: How the player uses the world: a target eye at the centre of the screen with the options of what they aim at (chosen with the cursor or the scroll wheel), and key prompts near places with press or hold.

blocks.name: vehicle-shop
blocks.title: Vehicle shop
blocks.doc: A showroom: vehicles by category on the left edge (the real car stands behind), stats, a paint colour from swatches or any hex, cash or bank, a test drive, and buy with a confirm.

blocks.name: inventory
blocks.title: Inventory
blocks.doc: The player's items and a second container side by side: pointer-driven drag and drop (Shift half, Ctrl one), stack and swap, a tooltip, weight meters, use, and a hotbar with a HUD strip.

blocks.name: mdt
blocks.title: MDT
blocks.doc: The shell of a police or EMS terminal: a nav (Dashboard, People, Vehicles, Reports), a search with a results list and a record pane, and a short report form behind a confirm.

blocks.name: phone
blocks.title: Phone
blocks.doc: A phone anchored bottom right: a status bar, a home screen of app icons and an app frame with a back action, with Contacts and Messages and a registry for your own apps.

blocks.name: scoreboard
blocks.title: Scoreboard
blocks.doc: Who's online with server IDs, names, jobs and ping, a search by name, ID or job, how full the server is, and which activities can start given who's on duty.

blocks.name: shop
blocks.title: Shop
blocks.doc: A catalogue grid by category with price and stock, a cart with steppers, cash or bank, and checkout with a confirm.
